name: cipher-mcp

tools.name: encrypt_text
tools.description: Encrypt plaintext with a cipher supported by cipher.tools.

cipher.description: Cipher id from cipher.tools, for example caesar or affine.

key.description: Cipher key exactly as required by the selected cipher.

plaintext.description: Text to encrypt. The upstream API accepts up to 500 characters.

format.description: Optional output formats, such as block:5 or case:upper.

tools.name: decrypt_text
tools.description: Decrypt ciphertext with a cipher supported by cipher.tools.

cipher.description: Cipher id from cipher.tools, for example caesar or affine.

key.description: Cipher key exactly as required by the selected cipher.

ciphertext.description: Text to decrypt. The upstream API accepts up to 500 characters.

tools.name: list_ciphers
tools.description: List ciphers currently exposed by cipher.tools.

tools.name: normalize_text
tools.description: Normalize text for classical cipher workflows by uppercasing, removing punctuation, and optionally preserving spaces.

preserveSpaces.description: Keep spaces in the normalized output. Defaults to false.

tools.name: validate_cipher_input
tools.description: Validate text and key shape for common cipher families before calling cipher.tools.

cipher.description: Cipher id, for example caesar, affine, vigenere, or playfair.

text.description: Optional text to validate for likely compatibility.

mode.description: Optional mode label for reporting. Defaults to encrypt.

tools.name: random_key
tools.description: Generate a plausible random key for supported cipher families.

cipher.description: Cipher id to generate a key for.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify that the cipher.tools API is reachable and report latency.

tools.name: examples_for_cipher
tools.description: Return ready-to-run sample input for a supported cipher family.

tools.name: detect_possible_ciphers
tools.description: Heuristically guess which classical cipher families may fit a piece of text.

instructions: Use these tools for classical cipher workflows, including encryption, decryption, normalization, validation, examples, and heuristic detection.
